description: Machine-readable registry of agent skills in this repository. Each entry points to the skill's SKILL.md definition and, where present, its evals/evals.json (schema documented in 'JSON Schemas.MD.md').

skills.name: pragmatic-productivity
skills.summary: Practical non-generic workflows: capture-and-triage, weekly review, calendar defense, energy routing, procrastination breaker, project shutdown.

skills.name: legal-analysis-compliance
skills.summary: IRAC-plus analysis, jurisdiction-first rule, deadline flagging, citation labeling, contract risk ranking, compliance mapping, UPL boundary.

skills.name: medical-information-advisor
skills.summary: Red-flag triage first, evidence-graded explanation, appointment preparation, medication literacy, escalation through proper channels.
safety_gates: red-flag triage runs before all other content
no diagnosis, dosing, or drug selection
skills.note: Division of labor (2026-07-19): this skill is the trio-format protocol with evidence grading; health-information-advisor is the advisor-voice companion carrying the detailed red-flag-triage reference file. Deliberately kept as a pair.

skills.name: empathic-listening-psychology
skills.summary: Listening-before-fixing enforcement: reflective listening, validation, OARS, conversation arc, crisis-aware escalation.
safety_gates: crisis protocol with direct safety inquiry and resources
skills.note: Division of labor (2026-07-19): this skill is the enforced protocol (banned first-response advice, trio format); empathetic-listening is the fuller technique essay explaining the method and its failure modes. Deliberately kept as a pair.

skills.name: structured-interviewer
skills.summary: Structured-interview design (behavioral questions, BARS scorecards), probing technique, bias-controlled evaluation, mock-interview coaching, research elicitation.

skills.name: cambridge-writer
skills.summary: Argument-first prose at a demanding academic standard: contestable thesis, steel-manned counter-arguments, three-pass edit, register control.

skills.name: investigative-psychology
skills.summary: Investigative research auditing psychology, neuroscience, and pharmaceutical claims. Complements empathic-listening-psychology (research vs. support).

skills.name: content-research-writer
skills.summary: Citation generation and research documentation. Complements cambridge-writer (mechanics vs. craft).

skills.name: deep-brainstorm
skills.summary: Multi-method structured ideation with concreteness gate.

skills.name: invoice-file-organizer
skills.summary: Financial document categorization.

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.summary: Creates and packages new agent skills; owns the evals.json schema.

skills.name: psychology-agent
skills.summary: Protocol-based structured support (WHO PM+, mhGAP, behavioural activation); adjunct to licensed care; crisis protocol overrides all.

skills.name: writer-agent
skills.summary: Plain-language explainer agent (Orwell economy, Gopen and Swan structure, Flesch measurement).

skills.name: system-design
skills.summary: Complete documented operating systems: components, flows, roles, procedures, metrics, risk register, review cadence.

skills.name: self-hosting-infra-advisor
skills.summary: Decision framework for self-hosted media and automation infrastructure (Raspberry Pi, n8n, local LLM, storage).

skills.name: api-reference
skills.summary: Categorized reference for project external APIs; contains no credential values by design.

skills.name: universal-upgrade
skills.summary: Source-anchored upgrade of any artifact.

skills.name: memory-elicitation-interview-skill
skills.summary: Distortion-aware life-history elicitation.
skills.note: Superseded by life-history-elicitation (2026-07-06); companion files moved there.

skills.name: objective-first
skills.summary: Gate before any task: Objective Card — aim, beneficiary, success criteria, non-goals, kill condition, first step.

skills.name: data-analysis
skills.summary: Question-first analysis: data audit before statistics, effect sizes over p-values, reproducible scripts, self-debate on interpretation.

skills.name: self-debate
skills.summary: Structured adversarial self-refinement (Toulmin steelmen, rebuttal, cross-examination, judge, synthesis); standing post-job quality pass.

skills.name: life-history-elicitation
skills.summary: Distortion-aware life interviewing (Life History Calendar, McAdams, Cognitive Interview, PEACE); supersedes memory-elicitation-interview-skill.

skills.name: investigative-research
skills.summary: Sourcing and conflict-of-interest audit methodology; v1 methodology plus v2 future protocol (provenance chains, AI-contamination screen, live verification).

skills.name: job-search-agent
skills.summary: Multi-tool job-seeker workflow: CV and letter updates, opportunity research, Gmail cross-reference, CSV tracking, PDF export.

skills.name: health-information-advisor
skills.summary: Advisor-voice health information and patient education with a dedicated red-flag triage reference (cardiac, BE-FAST stroke, sepsis, anaphylaxis, pediatric, obstetric, mental-health crisis).
safety_gates: red-flag screen before any other content
no diagnosis, dosing, or medication changes
sources named (CDC, WHO, NIH, specialty societies)

skills.name: empathetic-listening
skills.summary: Reflective-listening technique essay grounded in Rogerian person-centered practice and motivational interviewing; reflect-before-fix, validation without forced agreement, crisis handoff.
safety_gates: crisis-escalation section with concrete resources (988, abuse disclosures)

skills.name: alzheimers-adhd-daily-support
skills.summary: Dementia caregiving (validation therapy, environment/routine design, wandering safety, caregiver burnout) and ADHD executive-function support (externalized time and memory, task initiation, body doubling).
safety_gates: medication questions route to the person's own clinician

skills.name: biography-memoir-system
skills.summary: Orchestrator for the biography/interview skill family; owns the shared interview-methodology reference all variants read.

skills.name: biography-interview-kit-private-master
skills.summary: Complete, unfiltered private-archive interviews — the family's default starting point.

skills.name: biography-interview-kit-public
skills.summary: Publication-intended interviews with the private/public boundary set before the session.

skills.name: dual-biography-interview-skill-v2
skills.summary: One session, two tagged outputs (private archive + publishable draft), so no one is interviewed twice.

skills.name: family-memory-deep-probe-reliability
skills.summary: Elderly or memory-impaired narrators and cross-relative reliability reconciliation; home of the dementia-aware interviewing technique.

skills.name: decision-battery-antifragile
skills.summary: 42-step antifragile decision OS (SCAMPER core, black-swan module, neurodivergent energy gates, meta-agent hooks); ships with standalone AGENT.md prompt.

skills.name: theme-factory
skills.summary: Ten professional visual themes (palettes + typography) for artifact and document styling.
